name: Timeless
source:
I've forgotten my past and now I feel like I'm nothing. But this strange red haired man says he might be able to help me. Can I trust him, or will I forever be in the dark about who I really am?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25946]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
我忘记了自己的过去，如今觉得自己一无是处。但这个奇怪的红发男人说他也许能帮我。我能相信他吗？还是说，我永远都只能蒙在鼓里，不知道真正的自己是谁？

[译自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25946]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
